properties.statement: Wrote Python over the committed export to enumerate every open field-reported defect record — counting those carrying a defect marker, subtracting the ones some record already claims to have answered, then bucketing the remainder by date, edge degree, and whether their own text declares a fix. This is the "how big is the backlog actually?" question, and no served tool answers it: the two that come closest ask a session-scoped question (what did MY changes make stale) or a per-finding one, not a design-wide inventory.
